tasks.analysis: Fungi, a group of organisms that include mushrooms and yeast, are not plants but a separate branch of life. They can be found in almost every environment and play essential roles in various ecosystems. Many of them are decomposers, meaning that they break down organic matter and recycle nutrients back into the soil. Some fungi form symbiotic relationships with plants, helping them absorb water and nutrients. While many fungi are beneficial, others can cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans. 真菌是包含蘑菇和酵母菌在内的一类生物，不属于植物，而是独立的生命分支。它们几乎存在于所有环境中，并在各类生态系统中发挥重要作用。许多真菌都是分解者，能够分解有机物，将营养物质重新归还到土壤中。有些真菌与植物形成共生关系，帮助植物吸收水分和养分。虽然大多数真菌是有益的，但也有一些会使植物、动物和人类患上疾病。
